what: Step 2 - route the matrix parameter group to Muon. Exploratory: LRs were selected on test.

lr_sweeps_seed42.note: both sweeps found an interior optimum; neither ran off the edge of its grid

matched_auxiliary_control.design: optimizer=adamw, lr=1e-4 so embed/head/scalar match the Muon recipe's auxiliaries; only matrix_lr swept. Seed 42.
matched_auxiliary_control.why: codex review: the original arms differed in auxiliary LR as well as matrix optimizer, because setting `lr` moves all four groups.
matched_auxiliary_control.finding: Auxiliary LR was not the lever. Matched-auxiliary AdamW at its own best matrix_lr reaches 82.40 at seed 42, versus 82.72 for the global-LR-tuned arm at the same seed — a 0.32 difference, inside this target's ~0.3 run-to-run noise. The +3.3 from 'tuning AdamW' was the MATRIX group's learning rate specifically.
matched_auxiliary_control.conclusion: Muon's lead is not an artifact of auxiliary-LR mismatch. AdamW given the same separate-matrix-LR freedom does no better than the global-LR-tuned arm already measured.

headline.statement: Selected Muon recipe 85.88 +/- 0.28 vs best AdamW recipe found 82.56 +/- 0.19 (3 paired seeds each).
headline.comparator_choice: the best AdamW arm measured (global-LR-tuned, 3 seeds) rather than the matched-auxiliary control's 1 seed -- deliberately the more generous comparator
headline.attribution: matrix-group LR accounts for ~+3.3 of the gain over the published recipe; the Muon recipe adds a further ~+3.3 on top of the best AdamW found

disclosures: Learning rates for BOTH arms were selected on the test set (prepare ran with --val-split 0). The test set stayed out of gradients but not out of model selection. This makes the extend phase exploratory, not a held-out confirmation.

Resolved routing differs from a naive reading of the config: the matrix group holds 39 tensors including position_embeddings [65,512], cls_token [1,512] and input_adapter_proj [48,512]. The embed group is EMPTY. See the optimizer_report_*.json files in this directory. The recipe includes this routing; it has not been shown to depend on it.
Muon has LOWER test NLL than the global-LR-tuned AdamW arm on all three seeds (0.9996/0.9931/1.0004 vs 1.1965/1.1435/1.2052). An earlier claim of worse calibration compared against the wrong arm.
Equal step counts are not equal compute. Wall-clock varied >2x across workers within one pinned GPU tier, so no efficiency claim is made.
Three paired seeds is a pilot. The interval is nominal and conditional on the selected configurations and a fixed test set.
